title: Room for improvement
body:
Application is very simple and organised.

A couple of improvements I would to is:

* Having the option to put a quote or the percentage of the goal in the daily notifications. 

That is it for now. 

I hope the developer sees this and starts thinking how to implement changes like these 

Thanks

title: Excellent Habit Tracker – “Days Since” is a Game Changer!
body:
I don’t usually write reviews, but I felt like I had to for this one. I’ve been using Days Since for a couple weeks now and honestly, it’s been a game changer. I mainly use it to track personal stuff and other random things I’m trying to stay consistent with, and it just makes everything feel more clear and motivating. 

The interface is simple, nothing too fancy, but that’s what I like about it. It just works. I was actually surprised by how good the free version is — like I haven’t even felt the need to upgrade yet because it already gives me what I need. 

There’s a few small things I wish it had, maybe a couple more customisation options & more/better widgets options, but overall, this app is solid. Definitely recommend if you’re trying to keep track of anything meaningful in your life.
